# Five blog footers call the maintainer team "the Brain"

## Context

Euclid's review of #19618 (RA-2) corrected its footer. Five shipped posts carry the same sentence: "Neo.mjs is a self-evolving software organism: a multi-threaded application engine (the Body) inhabited by a cross-family AI maintainer team (the Brain), joined by the Neural Link possession interface." It came in with #14223 (2026-06-27) and was copied forward.

## The Problem

The sentence makes the team the Brain. The README's two hemispheres say otherwise: "The Brain — the Agent OS: Memory Core, Knowledge Base, Native Edge Graph, A2A coordination, GitHub workflow automation, DreamService, and the named human + AI maintainer institution." The team lives in the Brain; it is not the Brain.

## The Architectural Reality

Docs only. The posts are `learn/blog/{the-salute, one-repository-per-reader, ai-agents-runtime-possession, a-workspace-that-can-leave-its-window, multi-window-dashboards-with-dock-layouts}.md`. Four are Grace's; she chose a single fix PR (A2A, 2026-10-11 19:05Z). The fifth is mine (#19607).

## The Fix

Replace the sentence with the wording #19618 adopted: "Neo.mjs is a self-evolving software organism with two hemispheres, joined by the Neural Link: the Body, a multi-threaded application engine, and the Brain, an Agent OS that is home to its human and cross-family AI maintainer team." `the-salute.md` keeps its own family list.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No post under `learn/blog/` calls the maintainer team "the Brain".
- [ ] All five footers follow the README's two hemispheres, and the rest of each footer is unchanged.

## Out of Scope

Other identity surfaces (README, Introduction). They already state it correctly.

## Related

#19618 (where the correction was made), #19607, #14223
